description:
A beautifully presented first floor apartment with a private balcony, ideally positioned, just moments from Hyde Park and the vibrant neighbourhoods of Notting Hill and Little Venice.

Flooded with natural light, the apartment features impressive floor-to-ceiling windows, elegant high ceilings and attractive wood flooring throughout, creating a bright and spacious feel.

Offered with share of freehold and a lease of over 980 years, the property also benefits from the freeholders’ joint ownership of a substantial basement storage area. Subject to the necessary planning permissions and consents, this space may offer future development potential, including the creation of a separate lease.

The building has recently undergone refurbishment to both its façade and communal areas and is professionally managed by an established and highly regarded managing agent, allowing owners to enjoy the benefits of share of freehold ownership without the burden of day-to-day management.

Perfectly located within approximately ten minutes’ walk of Paddington, Royal Oak and Bayswater stations, the apartment enjoys exceptional transport connections via the Elizabeth line, Heathrow Express, National Rail and multiple Underground lines, providing fast access across London and beyond.

Surrounded by an outstanding choice of cafés, restaurants, independent boutiques and green open spaces, this is an exceptional home or investment in one of central London’s most desirable locations.
